en_title: Ubisoft Among Suitors Trying to Buy Marvel's Blade, Dishonored Studio Arkane Lyon from Xbox
cn_title: 育碧跻身竞购者之列，试图从XBOX手中收购《漫威刀锋战士》和《耻辱》工作室Arkane Lyon
opus_summary: 据彭博社报道，至少三家公司已向微软提交收购Arkane Lyon的报价，其中包括育碧，其他竞购者身份尚未公开，微软也尚未接受任何报价。报道称，交易将让工作室继续完成《漫威刀锋战士》，该游戏预计在未来一到两年内推出。

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft is reportedly among multiple suitors preparing bids to try and purchase French developer Arkane Lyon, makers of the Dishonored series and the upcoming Marvel's Blade, from Microsoft in the wake of the first-party publisher's ongoing Xbox " reset ."
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，在第一方发行商微软持续进行XBOX「重置」之际，多家竞购者正准备出价，试图从微软手中收购法国开发商Arkane Lyon，育碧也在其中。Arkane Lyon是《耻辱》系列和即将推出的《漫威刀锋战士》的开发商。

paragraphs.en: According to a new report from Bloomberg, at least three companies have submitted bids to Microsoft so far, with Assassin's Creed publisher Ubisoft among them. The identities of the other bidders are not yet publicly known, but Microsoft has not accepted any bids yet. Bloomberg states that a deal would allow Arkane Lyon to complete its current project, Marvel's Blade, which the outlet says "is expected to be released within the next year or two."
paragraphs.cn: 据彭博社的一篇新报道，迄今已有至少三家公司向微软提交了报价，《Assassin's Creed》发行商育碧就在其中。其他竞购者的身份尚未公开，但微软也尚未接受任何报价。彭博社称，交易将允许Arkane Lyon完成其当前项目《漫威刀锋战士》；该媒体表示，这款游戏「预计将在未来一两年内推出」。

paragraphs.en: Arkane's other studio in Austin, Texas, was closed by Microsoft in 2024 as part of a larger series of project cuts and personnel layoffs. The Austin team had been responsible for the critically acclaimed studio's only flop, 2023's disappointing co-op vampire-hunting game Redfall, which IGN gave a 4 out of 10 in our review . Previously, Arkane Austin developed the buggy-at-launch-but-quickly-fixed immersive sim Prey as well as the beloved original Dishonored.
paragraphs.cn: Arkane位于德克萨斯州Austin的另一家工作室于2024年被微软关闭，这是更大规模的一系列项目削减和人员裁撤的一部分。Austin团队负责开发了这家广受好评的工作室唯一一款失败之作，即2023年令人失望的合作猎杀吸血鬼游戏《Redfall》，IGN在评测中给它打出了4分，满分10分。此前，Arkane Austin开发了沉浸式模拟游戏《Prey》以及深受喜爱的初代《耻辱》；《Prey》在发售时漏洞百出，但很快得到了修复。

paragraphs.en: Arkane Lyon, meanwhile, was responsible for the 10-out-of-10 first-person immersive sim Deathloop along with the outstanding Dishonored 2.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，Arkane Lyon负责开发了获得10分满分的第一人称沉浸式模拟游戏《Deathloop》，以及出色的《耻辱2》。

paragraphs.en: Four studios have been spun out of Xbox so far rather than being immediately shut down as part of the "reset": Double Fine, which has gone independent ; Compulsion Games, which has also gone independent ; Undead Labs, which has gone independent but signed a publishing deal with an unidentified company for State of Decay 3; and Ninja Theory, which unfortunately might close down after Microsoft had two deals for another company to acquire it fall through .
paragraphs.cn: 迄今已有四家工作室从XBOX剥离，而不是作为「重置」的一部分被立即关闭：Double Fine已独立；Compulsion Games也已独立；Undead Labs已独立，但与一家身份不明的公司签订了《腐烂国度3》的发行协议；Ninja Theory则不幸可能面临关闭，因为微软两次将其出售给另一家公司的交易都未能达成。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN的前瞻内容执行主编、IGN每周XBOX节目《Podcast Unlocked》的主持人，也是《Next-Gen Console Watch》的联合主持人。他来自North Jersey，所以他认为应该叫「Taylor ham」，而不是「pork roll」。可以在X上通过@DMC_Ryan与他辩论这个问题。
